main_text.head: De columbis.
main_text.p: AGallinaceo genere proximum est columbaceum ninoris in re cibaria vsus quàm gallinaceum. Varro columbas diuitias putat, quod in summis columninibus villa nidificent.

Xenophon libro expeditionis Cyri primo tradidit Syros columbas habere sacrosanctas, nefas putare eas violare. Ante bellum ciuile Pompeianum in magno fuerunt pretio. Nam L. Axius eques Rom. denarius quadringentis singula pariauerat. Nam magnis in rebus fuerunt interpreti, epistolas annexas earum pedibus obsidione Mutinensi in castra confulum Decimo Bruto mittente.

Multa funt illarum genera, quæ omnia percensere superuacaneum est. Aristoteles prolem vernam præstantiorem affirit quàm autumnalem, deterrimamq; estiuam. Galli aliqua vernam fœturam damnant improbantq;, quoniam pulli non perueniant ad volatum tempestiuum, cum sæpe propter imbres veris largiores in nidis intereant, vel etiam ouâ vitiantur. Præstantissimam ad volatum & cibos prolem existimat Iulio vel Augusto mense natam; messis enim tempore pulli maximè pingues inueniuntur propter pabuli copiam. Calor enim columbis, vt & cæteris animantibus generibus, vtilissimus, imbres vero inimicissimi. Delectantur mi-rum in modum sale, ideoq; cibaria illa salsa crescunt.

page.notes: The left-margin note "Verna columbarum fœtura cur damnentur?" is printed in the margin, not in the text. Doubtful readings: the first line of the text uses large initial "A" with the rest of the word "Gallinaceo" in italic; the word "ninoris" and "columninibus" in the first paragraph are doubtful, as are "Pompeianum", "Aristoteles", "illarum", and "pingues" (readings uncertain from the scan). The line ending "pariauerat" and "singula" in the Xenophon paragraph is uncertain. The last line "brius" at the foot of the page is partly cut off and the catchword is not clearly visible. Greek is not present. Transcription is approximate for the italic passages and may contain errors.
